notes:
Fixes for resource packs and Client Mods controls:

- Keep the Unbox name badge font and approved logo artwork at the highest resource priority, while preserving custom world textures and fonts.
- Stop Inventory Sort from continuing enhanced drag and scroll gestures after Mouse Tweaks is disabled.
- Block Effortless Building shortcuts before opening menus when disabled or outside Creative mode; discard queued disabled clicks.

Includes the existing skin library layout, logo ownership and friend synchronization fixes. Supports Minecraft 26.1 / 26.1.2 / 26.3 with native Fabric and NeoForge modules. Close Minecraft before updating, then restart the game.
